cv: 3-fold GroupKFold grouped by run_id; evaluation on 17 clean-pool subjects
interpretation: M2 currently leads full-repetition character accuracy but its pooled AUC is slightly below M0. M3a has the strongest AUC and is above M0 in 14/17 subjects, while its character accuracy is below M2. Temperature scaling reduces NLL for M2 and M3a, increases ECE for both, and does not improve locked-stopping accuracy on these OOF sequences.
limitations: Locked-stopping results remain on the clean-pool OOF data, not the frozen evaluation population.
NLL/ECE after temperature fitting are in-sample with respect to the OOF calibration scores; use nested cross-fitting for an unbiased calibration estimate.
Fusion has not been evaluated on inner OOF scores, so finalist selection is not locked.
CNN sequence-level grouped CV did not finish on the available CPU; no CNN result is reported.
next_gate: Evaluate the saved OOF logits through the fixed LM fusion and stopping pipeline on inner validation only; lock finalists before Phase 8.
